name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-due-date-extension-event
_comment: Additive current-engagement event timestamp for the per-reviewer due-date override. Null means no active extension is recorded; the timestamp is cleared when the override is restored and on engagement reset.

attributes.displayName: Review Due Date Extension Granted At
attributes.description: Timestamp when the current reviewer engagement's due-date extension was granted. Nullable and current-state only; not an append-only audit of prior extensions.
